sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The high pressure oil system must be actuated during start up - up to approx 90% 
rated speed of the generator. Also during shutdown the high pressure oil 
system is to be activated between 90% of the rated speed until has teached 
standstill

The high pressure bearing oil pump is to be in operation whenever the turbine 
shaft is turning at any speed below approx 90% of rated speed.

The high pressure oil pump set is mounted on the bearing oil plant. The AC motor 
is for normal operating condition the DC motor is for stand-by.

The high pressure oil pump is adouble bank radial piston pump with five pistons 
per bank with three delivery connection.
The oil pressure is controlled by pressure switches.

The shaft can be rotated manually when high pressure oil is properly applied to 
the bearings.

 teeth carefully.

Erect the coupling hubs so that the inner sides close flush
